verdict.rationale: Zoho explicitly states API parity as a design goal ('perform all the operations that you do with our web client'), backs it with a large, verified OpenAPI spec covering contacts, banking, reconciliation, rules, orgs, and 1099 workflows, plus documented OAuth scopes gating module access. However, there is no independent/hands-on verification confirming true 1:1 parity (e.g., UI-only settings, some organization-level admin actions), and the llms.txt/well-known OpenAPI discovery probes 404, showing openness/discoverability gaps for AI-native tooling. Missing for 10: independent confirmation of full UI-API parity with no exceptions, and standard machine-discoverable API metadata (llms.txt, well-known openapi.json) actually resolving.
